newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end lower on new reserve period.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end lower on new reserve period.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed lower on Wednesday as banking operations returned to normal at the beginning of a new reserve period following active attempts by banks to cover negative positions on Tuesday, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate eased to close at 6.221 percent against Tuesday's 6.489 finish -- still above the central bank's 5.0-5.5 percent target zone -- with 30-day commercial paper down to 5.65-5.75 against 6.00-6.25.
Dealers said they expected the rates to continue a gradual downward correction from Tuesday's strong uptick.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 5.8375-8380 against 5.8400.
